sections.shortTitle: Sindh Disposal Of Urban Land Repeal Ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Short title, commencement and application

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
Sindh Disposal Of
Urban Land (Repeal) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance to repeal
the Sindh Disposal of Urban Land Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 11th November, 2005]
No. S.Legis.l(14)/2005, dated 11-11-2005.--The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title, commencement
and application.-----(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh Disposal of Urban Land (Repeal) Ordinance,
2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
